final_message:
I wrote the issues memo, `environmental-issues-memo.docx`; it passes the docx validation script and parses back cleanly. It covers 25 rated issues (5 Critical, 10 High, 7 Medium, 3 Low), each with recommendations, plus an action plan, proposed PSA revisions, a document request list and appendices on report conflicts, seller misstatements and key exceedances. The main findings: the draft PSA leaves the buyer almost no recourse because its own consultant reports make every identified condition "known to Buyer"; the site is out of compliance (overdue biennial certification, no groundwater sampling since 2020) despite the seller claiming regulatory closure; the buyer's consultant may also be the seller's LSRP of record (seller and NJDEP name different LSRPs); and the $750,000 environmental budget is materially understated.
